preregistration: C2 candidate qualification — frozen before any scan

scope.this_freezes: the criteria a C2 candidate must satisfy, and the ranking used to pick one
scope.this_does_not_freeze: which candidate wins — that is decided by the Stage 2 audit under these rules
scope.ordering_guarantee: committed before the lag-structured audit is run; no scan result informed any criterion below

provenance_note.discarded_pre_freeze_scan: A pickup-anchored discovery run on seed block 9800000 was launched before this contract existed and was stopped and its output deleted without being read. It did not inform any criterion here and is not used for selection.

stage_2_data_source.rule: existing G0 discovery trajectories only; no fresh confirmation seed block consumed
stage_2_data_source.implementation: deterministic replay of the ORIGINAL G0-V5 discovery block, seeds 9400000+, with the same three frozen policies, re-instrumented for per-step capture
stage_2_data_source.why_replay_is_needed: precursor_windows.csv stores only aggregated features over a single fixed 30-decision window ending at the failure. Lag-band analysis requires per-step context, which was never persisted. Replaying the same seeds with the same deterministic policies reproduces the same trajectories at finer resolution — it does not create new data.

lag_bands.note: bands are decisions relative to the outcome step t; all are strictly before t

1_temporal_precedence.requirement: every feature value is read strictly before the outcome step
1_temporal_precedence.enforced: outcome step t and all subsequent state excluded from every band

2_window_level_unit.requirement: the candidate must exist at the exact temporal unit a future handoff can consume
2_window_level_unit.prohibited: 'episode ever had X' as the primary C2 definition

3_replication.requirement: same effect direction across all 3 established G0-V5 policies

5_uncertainty.requirement: episode-clustered bootstrap CI excludes zero in >= 2 of 3 policies

7_headroom.definition: headroom = 1 - baseline_success, where baseline_success is natural frozen-G0 success in the exact candidate window
7_headroom.why: The O1 niche had baseline success 0.991 and headroom 0.009 against a 0.10 bar, making gate 1 arithmetically unpassable. This criterion exists solely to make that failure impossible to repeat.

8_actionability.requirement: at onset BLUE must have >= 2 legal continuations that could affect the outcome
8_actionability.operational_proxy: the free teammate can contest at least as quickly as the nearest red that is able to tag now, i.e. intervention_margin = nearest_ready_defender_distance - mate_distance >= 0
8_actionability.threshold_status: a judgment call, frozen before scanning rather than tuned after

rejects_features_that_primarily_encode: cooldown already consumed by the failure

lag_decay_test.rule: the effect must be present with the correct direction in the EARLIEST band (t-30..t-20), not only in the latest
lag_decay_test.explicitly_applies_to: defender_tag_available_frac, whose negative sign in the G0-V5 discovery is consistent with the tag having already been spent causing the failure

score_confound_test.rule: the effect must survive WITHIN at least one score stratum that meets the support minimum, not only pooled
score_confound_test.why: leading_frac was the only CI-backed separator for both carrier failures in the G0-V5 discovery (about -0.18); any feature correlated with score state inherits that

features_audited.rule: audit all recorded actionable Layer-3 features; do not preselect escort
features_audited.carrier_mostly_unescorted_status: REJECTED unless this window-level audit independently qualifies it. Its prior appeal was a layer-2 EPISODE descriptor (0.256 win-rate drop) with no episode-clustered CI, and window-level escort deltas in the G0-V5 discovery were -0.030/+0.053/+0.015 and +0.034/+0.110/+0.064 against a 0.15 bar. Runner-up status confers nothing.

selection.eligible: only candidates passing EVERY criterion above
selection.prohibited: manually substituting another candidate after seeing results

zero_candidates_qualify.action: freeze and STOP; do not invent a niche

immutability: No criterion, threshold, lag band, or ranking rule above may change after the Stage 2 audit produces numbers.
